question: _______ is an organization representing the entire cooperative movement in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NCUI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NCUI:-**

 
 
• **It stands for National Cooperative Union of India and it represents the entire cooperative movement in India.**
 
• It was established in 1929 and is headquartered in Delhi.
 
• NCUI works towards the promotion and development of cooperative societies in the country.
 
• It provides various services to its members such as training, consultancy, and advocacy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **TRIFED:-**

 
 
• **It stands for Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India.**
 
• It works towards the socio-economic development of tribal communities in India through marketing of their products.
 
 
 
• **NFCSF:-**
 
 
• **It stands for National Federation of Cooperative Sugar Factories.**
 
• It represents the interests of cooperative sugar factories in India.
 
 
 
• **NABARD:-**
 
 
• **It stands for National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**
 
• It provides financial and other support to agriculture and rural development in the country.
